playable.description: False until every rule of the entry works in the game: it is then left out of character creation, level-up and spell choices and random treasure (Compendium.playable). Absent means playable.

ability_scores.description: The abilities this background can raise (+2/+1 or +1/+1/+1): three in the 2024 PHB; a book that lets any ability rise lists all six.

feat_params.description: Fixed parameters for the feat, e.g. Magic Initiate {"list": "cleric"}.

feat_choice.description: The player may pick another feat in place of `feat` (the default): a feat choice with this filter, e.g. {"filter": {"category": "origin"}} for any origin feat.

languages.description: Languages the background teaches, beside the two every character picks.

features.description: More the background gives, walked like species traits: a skill, language or tool pick (`choice`), or a sub-pick whose options grant proficiencies (a cult's patron, a home province).

tool.description: The tool proficiency; a background whose tool comes from a pick in `features`, or none, leaves it out.

choice.description: Set when the player picks one tool of this kind; id is then the default.
